item.title: 🎮 For every tricky drone, we have our own lethal trick The FPV interceptors of the Zapad Group of Forces daily clear the sky over the eastern bank of the Krasno-Oskol Reservoir.
item.description: For every tricky drone, we have our own lethal trick 🎮 The FPV interceptors of the Zapad Group of Forces daily clear the sky over the eastern bank of the Krasno-Oskol Reservoir. 🎯 The enemy goes all the way to reach our positions. For example, they send large UAVs, 'motherships', filled with small attack drones. But our guys showed some ingenuity and figured out how to fight back: 'We don't destroy the dropped drones, but the mothership drone itself. We hit it and attack sub-units fall from it,' said the drone operator with the call sign 'Mot'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🔹 Behind the scenes of the Kupyansk 'victories': revelations of a POW AFU serviceman Yuriy Fisenko was taken prisoner by servicemen of the Zapad Group of Forces. According to him,
item.description: Behind the scenes of the Kupyansk 'victories': revelations of a POW AFU serviceman Yuriy Fisenko was taken prisoner by servicemen of the Zapad Group of Forces. According to him, his unit was abandoned in Kupyansk direction without water and supplies, while their rotation... was reassigned for promotional videos. 'We had to stay at our positions because our rotation was taken to a training ground to shoot some videos, just to show what 'poster boys' they are,' the POW shared, revealing the reality behind the heavily publicised battlefield 'victories'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29618

Behind the scenes of the Kupyansk 'victories': revelations of a POW
AFU serviceman Yuriy Fisenko was taken prisoner by servicemen of the Zapad Group of Forces. According to him,
his unit was abandoned in Kupyansk direction without water and supplies, while their rotation... was reassigned for promotional videos.
'We had to stay at our positions because our rotation was taken to a training ground to shoot some videos, just to show what 'poster boys' they are,' the POW shared, revealing the reality behind the heavily publicised battlefield 'victories'.

item.title: ▫️ To make it automatic is what saves lives in battle At the training grounds of the Tsentr Group of Forces, servicemen are trained to provide first aid to the wounded
item.description: To make it automatic is what saves lives in battle At the training grounds of the Tsentr Group of Forces, servicemen are trained to provide first aid to the wounded quickly and without fuss. ▫️ The combat lifesaving training takes quite a long time. It’s not enough to just know how to put on tourniquets and bandages; immense endurance is required. In addition to a bulletproof vest, a rifle, and basic combat kit, a combat lifesaver carries a medical pack weighing about 30 kg. ✅ Making fast decisions with that kind of weight on you, especially under fire, is difficult both physically and mentally. That's why, in training, all actions are practised to perfection, so that, at a critical moment, the fighter does everything right. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29617

To make it automatic is what saves lives in battle
At the training grounds of the Tsentr Group of Forces, servicemen are trained to provide first aid to the wounded
quickly and without fuss.
▫️
The combat lifesaving training takes quite a long time.
It’s not enough to just know how to put on tourniquets and bandages; immense endurance is required.
In addition to a bulletproof vest, a rifle, and basic combat kit, a combat lifesaver carries a medical pack weighing about 30 kg.
✅
Making fast decisions with that kind of weight on you, especially under fire, is difficult both physically and mentally.
That's why, in training, all actions are practised to perfection, so that, at a critical moment, the fighter does everything right.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🔥 We detect and burn down A counter-UAV platoon leader of the 103rd Motorised Rifle Regiment (Yuzhnaya Group of Forces) with the call sign 'Pioner'
item.description: 🔥 We detect and burn down A counter-UAV platoon leader of the 103rd Motorised Rifle Regiment (Yuzhnaya Group of Forces) with the call sign 'Pioner' spoke about the combat work of his unit in Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration: 'Our main tasks remain the same as they were in Konstantinovka: countering airborne threats, countering heavy UAVs, and destroying launch sites near Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka, Druzhkovka, and Kramatorsk. If the mission requires to neutralise an enemy stronghold or an important heavy UAV launch site, we operate in coordination with artillery units and destroy the launch point.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to deliver strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles at the defence industry enterprises and logistics centres, as well as ships
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to deliver strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles at the defence industry enterprises and logistics centres, as well as ships operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit: ▫️ in Kiev region – the logistics centre (HAVI Logistics Ukraine) in Trebukhov, the territory of which was used by units of the Ministry of Defence and other security structures of Ukraine to store dual-use goods; ▫️ in Kiev – DataGroup data centre, which was responsible for processing and transmitting intelligence data in the interests of the AFU; ▫️ in Odessa region – a dry cargo ship that delivered military cargo to the port of Chernomorsk. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
